components.text:
Circle: large circle, infernal chalk.

Only with Ascension. On a night of the lunar eclipse a witch-type performer opens the road from Deus Sanguis to Blood Sovereign for the one on the circle, or for herself.
Ascension's own demands stand: its Max EP threshold, a true Hero or true Demon Lord, Deus Sanguis mastered, and the wait since the last awakening. They agree by sneaking.
Costs an Ultimate Catalyst, a nether star and altar power; Deus Sanguis is given up. No bonus Max EP: that stays the altar's. The awakening wait is shared with it.
An eclipse happens on some full-moon nights (the server's chance). It lasts until dawn, and an eclipse also counts as a full moon for every rite that needs one.
